_comment: Source enum recovered from the per-source OnEventSelect* handlers in C_HMI_AUDIO_APP_BASE (the value each passes to CreateNotificationCommand): FM=1 AM=2 DAB=3 BT=5 CDC=6 AUX=7 iPod=10 Juke=11. 4 is not a valid source, which is why the first attempt fell back to FM. Force AUX as the default source. Two halves: (1) `media.settings` edits the seed database inside system.bin, and (2) `user_data` ships that database as the NAV/USER_DATA payload, because that is where the unit actually reads its live settings - system.bin extracts to the read-only /SYSTEM/, so editing it alone changes nothing (confirmed on the car: still booted to FM). user_data ships ONLY up_common.sqlite, deliberately, so the unit's other personal state is left as alone as this mechanism allows. LOCAL build manifest - the paths below are absolute for one checkout, so edit them before reusing. Force AUX as the default source. Step 1 of the plan in issue #72: a DATA edit only, so there is no code patch and nothing can be bricked. `supervisor.Last_Source` is the value C_MGR_SRC::StartUp() restores at boot (saved by C_MGR_SRC::ImmediateSourceSave()). AUX is position 4 per the 0-based source list in C_HMI_AUDIO_APP_BASE::GetSourceAtPosition(). If the unit ignores it, try varying supervisor.Last_Source_Priority (currently 1) alongside it. STATUS: 4 and 7 have both been flashed and neither started the unit on AUX - but neither flash is known to have applied, because the folder-name problem above would have skipped the payload silently in both cases. Rule that out first by renaming the folder to SMEG_PLUS_UPG and re-running tools/preflight.py. If a correctly-named flash still boots to radio, the numbering is wrong and 5 is the untried candidate: that is SRC_AUX in the audio module's own enum, whose name table is at 0x02f9d60c. The factory value is 1, which is the radio in every candidate numbering, so it does not tell them apart. See docs/AUX_CHAIN.md for all three and what is known about which one this key holds.
